A fish-like Pokemon. Barraskewda's jaws are said to be as sharp as a spear and strong like steel. It propels itself up to speeds of 100 knots (185 kph, 115 mph) by spinning its tail, and uses that speed to ram into its prey, spearing it.
A fish-like Pokemon. It has a wild temperament, and will use its horn to smash its way to freedom if kept in an aquarium. Humans swimming near it must exercise caution lest Goldeen ram them.
A fish-like Pokemon. Lumineon attracts its own prey by using the patterning on its wing-like fins, and typically competes with Lanturn for food.
A fish-like Pokemon. Remoraid is well known for its ability to shoot jets of water from the surface with incredible accuracy, often to shoot down flying insect prey out of the air.

A fish-like legendary Pokemon. Its body is a form it has constructed using its control over fire. Chi-Yu's flames burn at over 5,400 degrees F (3000 C, 15368 U), allowing it to melt rock and sand into lava that it can swim through.

A fishlike Pokemon. Veluza's main method of hunting comes from its ability to shed its own flesh. This boosts its offensive prowess and psychic power, as well as its agility, giving it an easier time when chasing down and tearing apart prey.

A flat, centipede-like Pokemon. Centiskorch creates flammable gas through fermenting the food in its body, and then burns these gases through the heat-generating organs along its underside. This results in overflowing flames emerging from the antennae on either end of its body.
A flat, circular Pokemon. A crest resembling an herb or branch is on its back. This crest is said to possess a mysterious power.

A flat, fish-like Pokemon with a broad body. Galarian Stunfisk leaves its red and white mouth, which looks similar to a Poke Ball, visible to lure in prey and then slams its fins shut on them so they cannot escape.

A flat, fish-like Pokemon with a broad body. Stunfisk's very tough skin keeps them unharmed if stepped on, even by sumo wrestlers. To exploit this, it buries itself in mud of the seashore and waits for prey to pass by.
A flat, thin Pokemon shaped like an eye with appendages that make it resemble a letter or a punctuation mark.

A flying cloud turtle and snake hybrid legendary Pokemon. Enamorus's love was said to have given rise to fresh life. However, it's also known to be vengeful to those who disrespect any form of life. It will descend from the clouds and deliver a wrathful, ruthless punishment in the process.
A fox-like Pokemon. A cunning thief, Nickit enjoys stealing food from others instead of spending their time finding food on their own.

A fox-like Pokemon. Hisuian Zorua retains its ability to cast illusions, but accomplishes this by constantly unleashing its spiteful power of malice through its ghostly fur, specifically atop of its head. This power comes from Hisuian Zorua's own resentment of everything.
A fox-like Pokemon. Zorua keeps its true form hidden to ensure its safety, and takes on the appearance of other Pokemon to frighten off enemies. Sometimes it will take the form of a silent child.

A fox-like, quadruped Pokemon. Alolan Ninetales can produce ice crystals from its fur, which it can use for both offense and defense. The ice crystals can act as a shield or form balls that can be fired like bullets with enough force to shatter rock.
A fox-like, quadruped Pokemon. Ninetales is a very vengeful Pokemon that has been known to curse those who mistreat it. This intelligent Pokemon is able to understand human speech easily.

A free-form blob with vestigial facial features. It is capable of transforming into an exact replica of any physical object. However, if Ditto tries to transform into something based on memory, it may get some of the details wrong.
A furry chinchilla-like Pokemon. Its fur feels amazing to touch, and it repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
A furry chinchilla-like Pokemon. Its tail acts like a broom as Minccino uses it to clean its den. It also brushes another Minccino with its tail to greet it.

A fuzzy, moth larva-like Pokemon. There are five slightly whorled horns on the sides of its head, which it can use to spit fire as a defensive tactic to deter predators. It has been seen using fire it spits from these horns to fly.
A ghost like mythical Pokemon. Hoopa has the power to transport things using teleportation, which warps space.

A ghost-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling a giant Misdreavus, albeit a highly fierce and aggressive one. It is said to float around the sky at night with its long hair writhing about it.
A ghost-like Pokemon. It spends its days sleeping in darkness and its nights startling people with mischievous tricks.
A ghost-like Pokemon. Mismagius can use advanced incantations for various purposes, such as causing misery or happiness. People that hear its cries will usually receive headaches and hallucinations.
A giant piscine Pokemon. Although powerful, Dondozo is dull and not very good at hunting, so it teams up with Tatsugiri to catch prey.
A gigantic, draconic alien legendary Pokemon. Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokemon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.
A gigantic, draconic alien legendary Pokemon. It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokemon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
A gooey Pokemon with the body structure of a snail. It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything.

A gooey Pokemon with the body structure of a snail. When it wants to move quickly, it will tuck its entire body into its shell, position the shell vertical to the ground, and roll itself away. It can also use its shell to float on water.

A group of small, bipedal Pokemon. The six members rely on teamwork as their strategy to win battles, and constantly change formation when they fight. The five troopers follow their brass loyally, and the brass's orders are considered absolute by them.

A hoofed quadruped Pokemon with a long neck. Girafarig's tail possesses a head of its own. However, this head is incapable of independent thinking and relies on outside stimuli such as smell to guide its actions.
A huge Pokemon based on the blue whale. When it is jumping out of the water, it makes a giant splash due to its large size. It can dive deep at 10,000 feet (3,000 meters) in one breath.
A huge, bipedal Pokemon. It wakes up only to eat and seldom for exercises. It is not a picky eater, as its strong stomach allows it to eat even moldy food without feeling any ill effects.
A huge, bipedal Pokemon. The gouges in Aggron's armor from previous battles are worn as mementos. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled.
A humanoid Pokemon resembling a fish. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

A humanoid Pokemon resembling a waterfowl. Quaquaval has a cheerful and energetic disposition, dancing away no matter what situation it faces. However, it is also stoic and very serious, especially when it comes to consistently polishing its skills.

A humanoid Pokemon said to have been born from burnt charcoal. Charcadet has a fiery fighting spirit, and will battle opponents tougher than itself. When it fights, its firepower increases, reaching temperatures of over 11768 U (1800 F, 1000 C).

A humanoid Pokemon whose appearance resembles a samurai. Kingambit has a battle-hungry disposition, and will not stop until it gets what it desires. It is flawed at devising complex strategies, but is still extremely powerful.

A humanoid Pokemon with a hollow torso that resembles a kimono. Froslass has the ability to freeze foes with its -58 F (-50 C) (9910 U) breath. It is thought to display its victims secretly after freezing them.

A humanoid Pokemon with a shell that resembles a bug. Its known to scatter glowing scales, which affect others by stimulating and healing their bodies; however, these scales are also dangerous if too many are touched at once.

A humanoid Pokemon with an ovoid body. Hitmonlee's legs freely contract and stretch similar to a coiled spring. This flexibility allows Hitmonlee to run with lengthy strides and gives it greater reach for its kicks.

A humanoid Pokemon with slim arms and legs. Gothorita uses starlight as the source of its power, and is able to use its psychic powers to arrange rocks to match the star. It can also use these powers to control people and Pokemon with hypnosis.

A humanoid Pokemon. Alakazam is able to use all forms of psychic abilities. These powers are used to move its body, as opposed to its weak muscles. It also uses its psychic powers to hold up its head, which is too heavy to be supported by its neck, due to its continually growing brain.
A humanoid Pokemon. Electivire is known to be recklessly careless regarding enemy attacks. It uses its tails to make contact with its opponents, and shocks them with over 20,000 volts.

A humanoid Pokemon. Gothitelle's immense psychic power can distort the space around it, showing visions of distant stars and past events. It can predict the future from the placement and movement of stars, and weeps when it discovers the lifespan of its Trainer.
A humanoid Pokemon. Grimmsnarl's hair works like muscle fibers and helps enhance its strength. Grimmsnarl is able to move its hair, and uses them to ensnare opponents in a tentacle-like fashion.
A humanoid Pokemon. It is able to throw punches too quick to be seen with the naked eye. By punching with a corkscrew motion, it is even capable of drilling through concrete.

A humanoid Pokemon. It is known to do false acts of forgiveness, luring in opponents and getting down to its knees, before stabbing them with its hair. It is believed that Morgrem has the ability to make plants grow.

A humanoid Pokemon. Kadabra emits alpha waves strong enough to induce headaches, and can even cause clocks to run backwards, machines to malfunction, and delicate devices to cease functioning altogether. When it has a headache, the alpha waves become unusual.
A humanoid Pokemon. Ralts uses its horns to read people and Pokemon's emotions. Warm feelings cause its body to warm as well, but it hides if it senses hostility.

A humanoid Pokemon. Tinkaton wields a crude, gigantic metal hammer that weighs over 220 pounds (100 kg) and is larger than its own body. The hammer appears to have been made using the old hammer Tinkaton had as a Tinkatuff for the base, with several scraps of metal colored in varying shades of gray and purple welded onto it.

A humanoid Pokemon. Tinkatuff carries a large, gray, crude yet sturdy hammer, with loose metal plates for the hammer head and what appears to be the old hammer Tinkatuff had as a Tinkatink on top of the shaft.

A humanoid Pokemon. Tyrogue is famous for its eagerness to compete and boundless energy, to such an extent that it will challenge anyone, even larger foes. Determined to make itself stronger, Tyrogue will not quit no matter how many times it loses.
A humanoid feline Pokemon. It can often be very attached to its Trainer, and it will become upset if its Trainer gives attention to other Pokemon.
A humanoid legendary Pokemon. It fights by confusing its opponents with its nimble movements and kicks, and it draws type-based energy from its masks, imbuing its cudgel with different elements.
A humanoid like Pokemon. Florges claims well-tended flower gardens as its territory, and it basks in energy emitted from flowers to obtain power.
A humanoid, Djinn like mythical Pokemon. Hoopa Unbound is said to be Hoopa's true form. Hoopa Unbound is said to have the power to bend dimensions which allows it to seize anything in the world.

A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a person meditating. Meditite heightens its inner energy and spiritual power through meditation, which allows it to levitate. It trains hours a day, and never skips its daily yoga training.

A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a scarecrow made of cacti. Cacturne is a nocturnal Pokemon that rarely moves during the day, which allows it to hold moisture. At night, it searches for prey or follows travelers until they become exhausted.

A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a yoga practitioner. Through the power of meditation and fasting, Medicham has developed a sixth sense. This allows it to use psychokinetic powers, and it heightens its energy to enhance this sixth sense.
A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon. Machop's entire body is covered with muscles that will never tire or cramp. With these muscles, it can lift many times its own body weight.

A humanoid, rabbit-like Pokemon. Due to its thick and fluffy fur, Raboot is protected from the cold and can use hotter fire moves. Raboot usually practices its footwork by kicking berries from a tree's branches and then juggling them with its feet.
A hybrid fossil Pokemon. By shaking its freezing upper half, Arctozolt can generate electricity. It was known to live on ancient shores and preserved its food with the ice on its body.
A hybrid fossil Pokemon. Dracovish is said to have been the apex predator of its time due to its powerful legs and jaws, and the ability to run at speeds exceeding 40 mph (60 km/h).
A hybrid fossil Pokemon. In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
A hybrid fossil Pokemon. It has trouble eating due to its mouth being on top of its head, even though it captures prey by freezing its surroundings.

A insectoid Pokemon with a steel body. Durant is extremely territorial. It only lives in colonies and digs mazes underground designed to be as complicated as possible. It grows steel armor to protect itself from its natural predator, Heatmor.
A jellyfish-like Pokemon resembling young royalty. It gently floats around in waves until it can strike its prey. It makes its victim numb with the use of its poison and takes it to its deep den.
A large Pokemon resembling a bell. It can summon rain clouds, which earned it the nickname "bringer of plentiful harvests".

A large Pokemon resembling an orangutan. This solitary Pokemon spends its time deep in the forest, meditating high up in the trees. While it is not normally active, it will provide food to hungry Pokemon and give medicine to injured ones.

A large Pokemon that resembles a mud statue. Its arms are not attached to its body, but are usually kept floating close by Claydol's psychic powers. Claydol uses the same telekinetic abilities to move and float through the air.
A large Pokemon that resembles a mushroom. The strange lights that it emits can confuse people who enter its habitat at night, causing them to be unable to ever find their way home again.
A large Pokemon that resembles a plesiosaur. Lapras is a gentle, helpful Pokemon that enjoys ferrying people across bodies of water.
A large Pokemon wrapped in vines. When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

A large Pokemon. Rhyperior can insert rocks and boulders into its arms through the holes in its hands and then fire them like bullets. However, it will occasionally insert and fire Geodude by accident.

A large Pokmon resembling a turtle. Drednaw's sharp jagged fangs are powerful enough to chomp on rock, iron, and steel rods. It can move very fast despite how extremely heavy the shell on its back is.
A large avian Pokemon resembling a raven. Corviknight's feathers are tempered with steel. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

A large avian Pokemon with a vulturine neck and broad, powerful wings. Fearow's large wings and stamina allow it to fly for an entire day without landing. It will shoot upward, and then dive down to catch prey.

A large avian Pokemon. Kilowattrel uses its throat sac to store the electricity that its wings generate, and can inflate the sac in order to amplify this electricity. When inflated, Kilowattrel's throat sac glows like a light bulb.

A large avian legendary Pokemon. Belligerent by nature and ever thirsting for battle, Galarian Zapdos seeks out opponents stronger than itself so it could test its might. Its powerful legs allow it to perform devastating kicks capable of destroying a dump truck, and it can run across mountains at up to 180 mph (290 kph).

A large avian legendary Pokemon. Galarian Articuno keeps itself airborne with its psychic power, almost never having to use its wings for this purpose. Instead, the blades on its wings can be used to slice through iron as easily as paper.

A large avian legendary Pokemon. Galarian Moltres attacks by spreading its wings wide to unleash its energy in a powerful aura that attacks the minds of its foes, inflicting deep fatigue as it burns away their energy from within. The aura has the power to consume the spirit of its victims, reducing them to burned-out shadows of themselves.

A large avian legendary Pokemon. Moltres sheds embers with every flap of its wings, creating a brilliant flash of flames. By dipping itself into the magma of an active volcano, this Pokemon can heal itself.

A large avian legendary Pokemon. When Articuno flaps its wings, it can chill the moisture in the air around it, making snow fall. According to legend, it appears before doomed travelers lost in icy regions.

A large avian legendary Pokemon. When Zapdos flaps its glittering wings, it releases electricity that can potentially cause thunderstorms. It produces massive crackling and snapping sounds when it flies; these are attributed to the lightning bolts it sheds when airborne.

A large bat-like Pokemon with enormous ears suited for precise hearing. From its ears, Noivern releases ultrasonic waves, which can be strong enough to shatter a large boulder. It uses these waves to freely navigate through darkness, allowing it to easily ambush prey under cover of night.

A large bipedal Pokemon, resembling a humanoid panda bear. With arms powerful enough to snap a telephone pole, it charges into battle like a berserker, heedless of any damage it might suffer as it bashes its opponents.
A large bird Pokemon. An impressive dive-bomber, it will never miss its target. Additionally, it takes great pride in its glossy plumage, and often cleans the wings of other Swellow.
A large cetacean Pokemon. Cetitan can use echolocation to find and communicate with others of its kind through sound waves. The sound Cetitan makes is said to be similar to a flute.

A large dragonfly Pokemon. Yanma is a skillful flier. It can make sudden stops, turn in midair and hover in place by flapping its wings at a high speed. It can also generate shock waves capable of breaking glass by flapping its wings very fast.
A large dragonfly Pokemon. Yanmega can create shock waves by beating its wings. These shock waves are so powerful, they may inflict critical injuries on the foe.
A large fish roughly formed from various smaller fish. Wishiwashi's powerful School Form is formed when a Wishiwashi is in danger and calls on its friends by making its eyes shine in an SOS signal.

A large fish-like Pokemon. Basculegion's evolution is said to be achieved by a surviving White-Striped Basculin being possessed by the deceased souls of other Basculin in its school who did not survive the harsh journey swimming upstream. When it senses danger, Basculegion will turn hostile and attack along with its souls until the enemy is defeated.
A large fish-like Pokemon. Seaking uses its powerful horn to bore holes in riverbed boulders in order to shelter its Eggs from water currents.
A large humanoid Legendary Pokemon. Zygarde Complete Forme is said to exceed both Xerneas and Yveltal in power, possessing 100% of its total cells.

A large jellyfish-like Pokemon. Tentacruel's tentacles can be freely elongated and shortened, and can absorb water to stretch to some length. The tentacles are normally kept short, but on hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

A large legendary Pokemon resembling a cloven-hoofed mammal such as a deer or a moose. Its body is a form it has constructed using its control over the earth. Ting-Lu is able to create fissures over 160 feet (50 meters) deep just by slowly putting down its head on the ground.

A large legendary Pokemon resembling a skeletal, legless bat. Known as the "beast that calls the moon," Lunala has long been honored as an emissary of the moon. This Pokemon constantly absorbs light to convert into energy.

A large legendary Pokemon resembling a white lion. Known as the "beast that devours the sun," Solgaleo has long been honored as an emissary of the sun. Its body is capable of holding a vast amount of energy and glows when active.

A large legendary Pokemon that resembles a dragon, a plesiosaur, and a bird. It is said that a light flutter of its wings is capable of causing winds powerful enough to tear down cliffs. If it were to flap its wings, it could hypothetically spawn storms lasting as long as 40 days.

A large legendary Pokemon with avian and draconian traits. Yveltal has the power to absorb life energy. When it reaches the end of its lifespan, it expands its wings and steals all of the life energy of every living thing around it before transforming into a cocoon to sleep for 1,000 years.
A large mushroom-like Pokemon. Toedscruel eats by wrapping prey with its tentacles and sucking out their nutrients, which causes the prey pain.

A large mythical Pokemon with a roughly humanoid build. Melmetal was known in ancient times to be worshipped for the ability to create metal. Due to the state of its liquid metal body, the arms are very flexible, capable of delivering power punches.

A large proboscidean Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Donphan, albeit one with gigantic tusks, tough scales, and an aggressive disposition. Unlike its present-day and future relatives, Great Tusk is never seen curling up into a ball, perhaps prevented by its enormous tusks.

A large reptilian legendary Pokemon. Koraidon dominates its opponents using its immense strength and the many natural weapons available to it, including its tough jaws and fangs, sharp claws, and thick, powerful tail.

A large robotic reptilian legendary Pokemon. It keeps itself afloat to maintain an advantageous position that applies pressure to grounded opponents, and it anticipates their moves before striking at their weak points. One strike from its charged tail is said to knock out even the sturdiest foe.
A large rodent Pokemon. If attacked, Raticate stands up on its hind legs, bares its fangs and shrieks in an intimidating manner at its enemy.
A large rodent Pokemon. It is selective in what it eats, only eating fresh, high quality foods.

A large sauropod-like Pokemon. It has a long neck, which it uses for reaching treetops to gorge on its most favored fruit. Since it ate only this kind of fruit continuously, the fruit began to grow around its neck.
A large sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.

A large sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.
A large spherical Pokemon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

A large, Ultra Beast. Although it constantly eats, its droppings have never been found. It is speculated that the entirety of the matter it consumes is converted into energy, with no waste products left over.
A large, avian Pokemon. Braviary is extremely aggressive, but for noble reasons. It will fight fiercely to help and protect its friends. Even if injured, it will still fight.
A large, avian Pokemon. Its powerful wings are capable of stirring up windstorms in just a few flaps, and it may spread its wings to intimidate enemies.
A large, avian Pokemon. When it hunts, it sends out a bloodcurdling battle cry to signal that it's hunting. It can use its psychic powers to unleash eerie screeches capable of generating shock waves.

A large, bat-like Pokemon. Golbat drinks so much blood, that its blood type will change to that of its victim following a feed. It is also gluttonous, occasionally gorging itself to the extent that it becomes too heavy to fly.

A large, bipedal Pokemon composed of rock salt. Garganacl's salt is rich in minerals and known to have medicinal properties. Garganacl will scrape its fingertips together to share its salt with injured Pokemon, which can heal them quickly.
A large, bipedal Pokemon covered in shaggy fur. Abomasnow appears only when snow flowers bloom. Once the flowers die, it retreats to isolated areas.

A large, bipedal Pokemon with distinct reptilian features. Nidoking uses this tail to smash, constrict, or break the bones of its prey and enemies. The tail can be swung to create distance between it and its foes before Nidoking charges.
A large, bipedal Pokemon with distinct reptilian features. When in contact with foes, it can poison them with the spikes from its back or cause small tremors by slamming the ground.

A large, bipedal Pokemon with features of both dinosaurs and rhinoceroses. Rhydon is a physically powerful Pokemon. It is recorded as being able to topple buildings with a sweeping blow of its tail, and its horn is able to bore through solid rock and shatter diamonds.
A large, bipedal Pokemon. It arrives with chilly, wintry winds and is feared by people as the guardian of the forest. It is able to read an opponents mind, and then take preemptive action.

A large, bipedal creature with a thick tail. Kangaskhan is a nurturing Pokemon that protects its young at all costs. If the mother feels the environment is safe, it will allow its young out to play. However, it will violently attack anything that it sees as a threat to its young.

A large, bipedal legendary Pokemon resembling a humanoid black bear with a wushu motif. Rapid Strike Style Urshifu prefers calmly observing the opponent and their strength while dodging. Urshifu strongly believes in defeating its opponents with many rapid blows nonstop like a flowing river.

A large, bipedal legendary Pokemon resembling a humanoid black bear with a wushu motif. Single Strike Style Urshifu prefers battling without holding back. It strongly believes in using the One-hit KO strategy. If enraged, it will mercilessly attack the opponent until utterly crushed.

A large, bipedal tortoise-like Pokemon. The powerful cannons on this Pokemon's back are capable of producing water blasts that can pierce steel and concrete. Blastoise deliberately makes itself heavy to withstand these powerful blasts, and it will crush its opponents with its bulk.

A large, bipedal, dinosaurian Pokemon with an armor-like hide covering its body. Tyranitar is a powerful Pokemon with an insolent nature. It is extremely strong, and its thick, rocky hide gives it a good resistance to all forms of attack. Because of this, it is always looking for a battle and will not flinch at anything.

A large, bipedal, frog-like Pokemon. Greninja moves with the speed and grace of a ninja, using swift movements to confuse its enemies while it slices them up with throwing stars made of compressed water; these throwing stars are sharp enough to split metal.
A large, bipedal, frog-like Pokemon. Through a transformation called Bond Phenomenon, Greninja can change into an alternate form called Ash-Greninja.
A large, bipedal, robotic dinosaur-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Tyranitar. It is said to be coolheaded and prefers to avoid unnecessary fights.
A large, bipedal, theropod legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Suicune. Walking Wake is capable of walking on water.
A large, bulky Pokemon that is modeled after a sumo wrestler. Hariyama's body consists mostly of muscle instead of fat. When its body tenses, its muscles become as hard as stone.

A large, bulky cyborg Pokemon that looks like a futuristic sumo wrestler. A mysterious life-form that resembles Hariyama. It is said to have fists that move independently of its body and to be capable of throwing large, fast-moving vehicles.
A large, bulky, bipedal ape-like Pokemon. It is considered the laziest Pokemon, but even when it is lounging it's saving energy. It can exert a lot of power by releasing built up energy all at once.
A large, canine Pokemon. Mabosstiff has a gentle temperament and loves playing with children. However, it will bare its teeth and take on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

A large, dinosaur-like Pokemon resembling a Pachycephalosaurus. A charging Rampardos can knock down virtually anything with one hit. It enjoys barging into objects with its head to train its strength and reflexes.

A large, dinosaurian Pokemon, closely resembling theropods such as Tyrannosaurus. Before its extinction, wild Tyrantrum used to live 100 million years ago, when its powerful jaw conferred its status as an unmatched predator. Since it was considered invincible in the ancient world, it behaved like a king.
A large, draconic Pokemon. It has savage physical strength; it nimbly chases prey around its den, using its outstretched claws to catch them.

A large, draconic legendary Pokemon. Giratina is able to travel through and control dimensions besides those of time and space. When in its Origin Forme, it is able to pass through dimensions at will, however, it will turn back to its Altered Forme due to the gravity change from the Reverse World.
A large, elephantine Pokemon. Copperajah's tarnished skin is resistant to water. It lives in social herds and its trunk is strong enough to crush boulders into powder.

A large, equine Pokemon. Mudsdale is known for both its powerful body and emotional fortitude, which prevents it from becoming agitated. Regardless of the trouble it is in, it will never cry out and defeats opponents with a single blow.
A large, fish-like Pokemon. Lanturn uses the bright part of its body to lure fish prey. It then blinds the prey with an intense burst of light, and swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

A large, flying creature that bears similarities to a dinosaur. It is capable of flying, but is more adept at running. It can outrun even an automobile. It has the intelligence to work with its partners in order to catch prey.
A large, golem-like legendary Pokemon. Regigigas is a skilled craftsman. It created golems out of inanimate objects and brought them to life.
A large, hippo-like Pokemon. It is short-tempered, and may hold its mouth agape as a display of strength.
A large, humanoid Ultra Beast with a bodily construction that closely resembles that of a bamboo shoot. Its most distinctive feature is the energy that it stores within itself

A large, jellyfish-like Pokemon. Jellicent can absorb seawater then project it from its head, which lets it move forward in the sea. Any ship or crew that wanders into the oceans where it dwells is never found again, and it is known to feed on life energy.
A large, ladybug-like Pokemon. When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
A large, manta ray-like Pokemon. Mantine can fly in the air if it builds up enough speed and can soar gracefully out of the water.
A large, menacing arthropod Pokemon in a hunched-over, humanoid posture. It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.

A large, moth-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form that shares traits with Volcarona. Some theorize that it may have been revived from fossils of a prehistoric era. However, no Volcarona fossils of that era are known to have been found.
A large, moth-like Pokemon. It is said that its fires can replace the sun when it is dark with ash, and it has been known to rescue freezing Pokemon.
A large, ovoid Pokemon. A small pouch on its belly holds a single egg, which brings feelings of happiness and makes a person pleasant and caring if ingested.
A large, penguin-like Pokemon. The edges of its wings can slice through ice floes, and this Pokemon will use them to attack anyone or anything that damages its pride.
A large, quadruped, feline Pokemon. Although popular for its elegance, it is extremely difficult to raise as a pet due to its fickle and temperamental personality.
A large, quadruped, feline Pokemon. It is described as highly intelligent and having an even higher opinion of itself.
A large, quadrupedal brown bear Pokemon. This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.

A large, quadrupedal brown bear Pokemon. Ursaluna's physique allows it to travel through swamps with ease and it can also manipulate the peat soil at will to its advantage. Ursaluna are known to be good at searching for items, and even missing persons, using their sense of smell.

A large, rotund, amphibian Pokemon. Bellibolt is capable of moving very quickly, but usually chooses to act sluggishly. It is difficult to train Bellibolt to initiate a battle because it has an easygoing temperament, and does not notice its opponents until it is attacked.
A large, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. Dialga can warp time by either speeding it up, slowing it down, or stopping it altogether.
A large, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokemon.
A large, scorpion-like Pokemon. Drapion is a very aggressive Pokemon, attacking anything that enters its territory.
A large, sea lion-like Pokemon. While its long tusks are capable of crushing ice, they may break during battle.

A large, seahorse-like Pokemon with a tightly curled tail. The yawn of a sleeping Kingdra is powerful enough to create undercurrents capable of destroying small ships. Should it decide to emerge from the depths of the ocean, Kingdras strength can create large whirlpools and sea-born tornadoes on the surface.

A large, serpentine legendary Pokemon. Rayquaza lives in the ozone layer, where it feeds on water and other particles. Rayquaza is rarely seen by people; even in flight, its appearance is indistinguishable from that of a meteor.

A large, skeletal, canine Pokemon. Houndstone spends much of its time buried below the ground, particularly in graveyards, with only its "tombstone" visible. Houndstone is considered the most loyal of all dog Pokemon.

A large, spherical Pokemon. Forretress can defend itself from enemies by shooting out pieces of its outer shell. It opens its shell to capture prey, but does so quickly that its interior body cannot be seen.
A large, sticky, amorphous Pokemon made of living purple sludge. Extreme caution is advised in avoiding any contact with this Pokemon, as an accidental brush up can lead to severe sickness.

A large, sticky, amorphous Pokemon made of living purple sludge. Its vivid coloration is a result of the garbage it eats, which causes chemical changes in its body; these same chemical changes are thought to be the cause of its unending hunger.

A large, theropod-like Pokemon. When in battle, Baxcalibur flips upside-down, using its spine as an axe while supporting itself with its head and forelimbs. It also spews out cryogenic air from its mouth, which is cold enough to freeze lava.
A large, theropod-like legendary Pokemon. It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things.
A large, theropod-like legendary Pokemon. Palkia has the ability to warp space, though it was said to create alternate realities as well.
A large, vaguely humanoid Pokemon with an egg-shaped body. When Magmortar prepares to shoot fire from its hands, the claws may disappear into its skin, forming something similar to a cannon.
A large, vampire bat-like Pokemon. Gliscor, along with its unevolved form Gligar, can emit a sort of sound wave in order to detect obstacles and fly around them, similar to echolocation.

A large, wingless, three-headed avian Pokemon. Each head has its own working brain and distinct personality, representing and expressing sorrow, anger and joy respectively. Despite being separate, it has the innate ability to use all three of its brains to collect data, formulate and then execute complex plans and strategies.
A lean, quadruped legendary Pokemon with feline features. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
A legendary titan Pokemon composed of ice. It can survive submerged in molten lava and other extremely hot temperatures.
A legendary titan Pokemon composed of metal. Dispite being made of metal, this material stretches and shrinks despite its hardness.

A legendary titan Pokemon composed of stone. When it gets damaged in battle it will search for new rocks to repair itself. Because of this, the rocks it is made of come from several different places, which contributes to Regirocks patchwork appearance.
A limbless Pokemon composed of magma. In order to prevent its body from cooling and hardening, Slugma neither sleeps nor ever stops moving.
A limbless, snail-like Pokemon consisting almost entirely of magma. Magcargo's internal body temperature can reach over 18,000 F (10,000 C) (27968 U), causing it to evaporate water on contact.

A living, bipedal boulder. Its preferred locomotion is rolling, specifically because it is a slow walker. It often rolls down mountain paths at high speeds, crushing objects in the way and stopping by running into huge rocks.
A living, bipedal boulder. The Alolan Golem is capable of firing a rock for attacking; if it is not available, it will fire nearby Geodude instead.
A living, bipedal boulder. The Alolan Graveler looks similar to their regular counterpart, with the addition of dravite crystals on parts of its body, and iron sand attracted by magnetism.

A lizard-like Pokemon. Heliolisk can use this electric energy to stimulates its muscles, boosting the strength in its legs and therefore enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds, or 20 yards per second.

A long Pokemon that seems to be perpetually buried within the earth. Wiglett has an exceptional sense of smell, which has a range of over 60 feet (20 meters). Wiglett is a timid and cautious Pokemon; it hides in the sand when it picks up the scents of other Pokemon, such as Veluza, nearby.
A long bodied Pokemon. They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
A long three-bodied Pokemon that lives in a black spiky rock. It is considered a particularly aggressive Pokemon species, wrapping its three bodies around prey and dragging them down to its lair.
A long, serpentine Pokemon made up of rock-like sections. It is capable of chewing through boulders with its powerful jaws, and its eyes are capable of seeing in the dark.

A long, serpentine Pokemon. Dragonair hosts a large amount of energy within its body, which it can discharge through the crystal orbs on its neck and tail. This causes its body to brighten and give off a different aura that changes the weather in its vicinity.
A long, worm-like Pokemon with a six-segmented metal body. Orthworm lives in dry deserts, and eats iron from the soil to maintain its body.

A long-bodied Pokemon similar to a mongoose. Gumshoos hunts by waiting along its prey's known travel routes. Due to its tenacious personality and ability to withstand intense hunger, it is able to wait for its prey for long periods without eating.
A long-bodied Pokemon similar to a mongoose. Yungoos has a voracious appetite and is always hungry. Much of its body is dominated by its stomach, and it is able to digest food quickly.
A mammalian, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a young panda. Pancham tries to make itself serious towards its foes, but its glare is not so intimidating.

A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. Eevee is said to have an irregularly shaped genetic structure that allows it to adapt to many different kinds of environments. Eventually, Eevee may evolve to better suit its surroundings.
A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. It will fluff out its collar to cool down its high body temperature. This high temperature is caused by its internal flame sac.
A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. This Pokemon's cellular structure is similar to plants, which allows it to perform photosynthesis and purify the air around it by sleeping under patches of sunshine.

A mantis-like insect creature. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. The stones that adorn Kleavor's body often get chipped during fierce fights; larger chips are a sign that it is experienced in battle.

A marine Pokemon resembling a Sea Cucumber. Pyukumuku tends to find a spot it likes and stay there, even returning to the same spot if moved. Once all the food in its favorite location has been consumed, it will continue to stay there to the point of starvation.

A marine Pokemon that resembles a cross between a sea lion and a mermaid. Primarina uses water balloons and its voice as its main weapons. Water balloons are released as it dances, and are controlled by its voice.

A marine sea urchin-like Pokemon. Pincurchin stores electricity in each spine, which flows from the tip of each one. If one gets broken off, it will still continue to emit electricity for approximately three hours.
A massive Pokemon seemingly formed entirely out of reflective ice. Its cumbersome frame is as hard as steel, able to crush anything that stands in its way.

A massive leonine-ceratopsia hybrid legendary Pokemon with some mastiff qualities. A mysterious life-form resembling Entei. Its rumored that Gouging Fire can make magma on the ground erupt by roaring.

A massive whale-like legendary Pokemon. Kyogre is said to be a powerful Pokemon, having control over the element of water and rain to have quenched areas of the world plagued with drought and to have expanded the seas.

A massive, bipedal, dinosaur-like legendary Pokemon. Groudon is an immensely powerful Pokemon, having the ability to summon intense droughts and cause volcanic eruptions. The droughts it can cause allow it to evaporate water, while the volcanic eruptions it can summon enable it to create land.
A massive, leonine quadruped legendary Pokemon. An Entei is born whenever a new volcano appears. It is also said that whenever Entei roars, a volcano erupts somewhere in the world.

A mechanical, bipedal Pokemon. A mysterious life-form similar in appearance to both Gardevoir and Gallade. It is a cruel Pokemon, willing to take its shining blade and cut down anyone confronting it without hesitation.

A medium-sized fish Pokemon. A long-lived Magikarp is able to utilize its immense splashing power to leap high enough to scale mountains. It also has a strong enough immune system to survive in the most polluted of waters.

A medium-sized mammalian Pokemon that resembles a skunk. Skuntank is known for its noxious fluid which smells dreadful. It can spray this fluid over 160 feet (48.8 meters), and the longer it allows the liquid to ferment within its body, the more powerful the smell.
A medium-sized, bipedal dragon-like Pokemon. Gabite is a fierce and predatory Pokemon, known for its scales, of which have medicinal properties and can heal most illnesses.
A medium-sized, bipedal, crocodilian Pokemon. Its teeth are positioned like barbed fishing hooks and are impossible to pull out with ordinary strength.

A medium-sized, penguin-like Pokemon with a large ice cube on its head. It can produce cold air from inside its head to create ice to protect its head from heat. The ice, however, is not very durable, as a strong blow can shatter it, after which it goes on to create new ice.

A metallic avian Pokemon. Its steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles, but once a year the battered wings grow back completely. This process restores the cutting edges. Its feathers are sharp enough to be used as blades.

A metallic, beetle-like Pokemon. Rabsca gently rolls its ball with its legs so that the infant inside can sleep comfortably. A hypothesis posits that the infant is actually Rabsca's true body, since the body that rolls the ball around barely moves.
A metallic, bipedal Pokemon. Gimmighoul is extremely timid, running away and dropping its coin as soon as anyone approaches.
A metallic, bipedal Pokemon. In its Chest Form, Gimmighoul's treasure chest provides defense but makes it hard for it to move due to its weight.

A metallic, bipedal mythical Pokemon that is made up primarily of spheres. It will try as hard as it can to save injured Pokemon, due to its ability to feel others pain. It can even perceive the emotions, thoughts, or feelings of other Pokemon as well.
A mole like Pokemon. Excadrill can straighten its entire body, allowing it to spin like a drill. It has the ability to cut through iron and steel plating.

A monkey-like Pokemon with a three-fingered hand at the end of its tail. Aipom uses its powerful tail freely and cleverly for many purposes. The tail is strong enough to anchor Aipom to a branch and suspend the rest of its body in the air, but also delicate enough to pick fruit and manipulate objects.

A monstrous, bipedal Pokemon which resembles a pepper plant. The spicy chemicals in its brain stimulate both heads, turning the green head vicious while providing a source for the red head to convert into spicy, fiery energy, which it blasts its surroundings with.

A moth-like Pokemon. Dustox is nocturnal and is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms are attracted by the bright light of cities where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
A moth-like Pokemon. Mothim is a nomadic, nocturnal Pokemon that always remains on the move, searching for honey and nectar.
A moth-like Pokemon. The ice scales from Frosmoth's wings can fall like snow while it flies over the fields and mountains. The wings have a temperature of -290 F (-179 C) (9678 U).
A mouse-like rodent Pokemon. Maushold creates and lives in huge nests comprising many rooms with different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.
A mouse-like rodent Pokemon. The pair that forms Tandemaus sticks together no matter what. They exhibit great teamwork
A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Thundurus can shoot thunderbolts from its tail.
A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Tornadus can travel at speeds of 200 mph (320 kph). It can also whip up storms with its tail, and is able to blow away houses.

A mushroom-like Pokemon with a cap that looks quite similar to a Poke Ball. It uses the Poke Ball-like pattern on its head to lure people and Pokemon in grassy areas, then releases a cloud of poisonous spores to defend itself.
A mushroom-like Pokemon with a large, Poke Ball designed cap with warts. It uses the Poke Ball-like patterns on its arms to lure in prey, though it doesn't work too well in most cases.

A mushroom-like Pokemon with large caps on its head and arms that resemble modern Poke Balls. A mysterious life-form combining traits of dinosaurs with those of Amoonguss. Its gigantic stature and seemingly low intelligence combine to make it a powerful and savage fighter.

A nearly spherical, quadruped Pokemon of indefinable basis. Munna is able to eat the dreams of people and Pokemon, as well as project these dreams by expelling Dream Mist. A person whose dream was eaten by a Munna will forget the dream's contents.
A pearl-like Pokemon encased within a spiky, bivalve shell. Its body is known to be soft and tender; however, its shell is said to be harder than diamond.

A pearl-like Pokemon that is encased inside a shell. With rapid succession, it launches its spikes at the foe, keeping them repelled. Once it has shut itself in, it is impossible to open its shell from the outside.
A pelican-like Pokemon whose head and bill make up the majority of its body. Skimming across the top of waves, it scoops food from the sea and swallows it in one gulp.

A penguin-like Pokemon with a hollow tail. Delibird carries food bundled up in its tail. It normally gives stored food to its chicks, but has been known to share its food with humans stranded on icy mountains.
A penguin-like Pokemon. Piplup has a strong sense of self-pride. Because of its pride, it has a hard time accepting food from humans and bonding with its caretakers.
A penguin-like Pokemon. Prinplup has a high sense of self-pride, which prevents it from forming groups of its own kind.
A pig-like Pokemon. Motion is achieved by bouncing on its spring-like tail. The bouncing has a vital function, in that it keeps its heart beating. Even while it is sleeping, it continues to bounce.
A pigeon-like Pokemon. Pidove is not particularly intelligent. While it always listens to its Trainers commands, it does not always understand them.
A pinecone-like Pokemon. It makes its shell thicker by gluing tree bark to its body. The glue is made of fluid that Pineco spits out, which hardens when it is exposed to air.
A pinniped Pokemon resembling a sea lion. By storing thermal energy within its body, it is completely unharmed by even the most intense freezing weather.

A pinniped Pokemon with three ruffle-like growths around its body. While Brionne normally learns to dance from members of colony, it can also learn to dance from humans. It works hard to memorize each dance through imitation.
A pinniped Pokemon. Its warm fur and thick hide allow it to swim in waters as cold as -40 F/C (9928 U). It thrives in these cold environments, becoming more active as the temperature drops.
A pinniped Pokemon. Popplio is able to snort bubbles of water from its nose, which it uses as part of its battle strategy.
A pinniped Pokemon. When it encounters new objects, they are placed on its nose and rolled around to test its smell and texture. It has also been known to roll Spheal on its nose.
A plant Pokemon resembling a human wearing a dress. Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen.
A plant like Pokemon. Eldegoss's cotton fluff acts like a cushion to protect its head from attacks. The cotton can also be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn.
A plant-based Pokemon with a stem-like body. This stem is long, thin and very flexible, making it capable of swerving rapidly to avoid many attacks or moving with blinding speed to capture prey.
A plant-like Pokemon that resembles a plant bulb, such as an onion. Its head is tipped with three oblong leaves that are very bitter. However, these leaves possess revitalizing effects.
A plant-like Pokemon. In order to prevent being washed away by ocean tides, the body of this Pokemon is heavy.
A plant-like Pokemon. Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

A plant-like Pokemon. The flower is on Lilligants head is very difficult to coax into bloom. Once it does bloom, it will wilt if Lilligant is then neglected. The flower emits a sweet smelling aroma, and it is believed to have a relaxing effect on those exposed to the scent.
A primate Pokemon, similar to a New World monkey. Mankey specializes in physical fighting, and is very aggressive and short-tempered. When angry, Mankey begins shaking and its breathing turns rough.
A pudgy bipedal Dragon-type Pokemon that appears to be made of goo. It is very affectionate and, when it hugs its Trainer, leaves them covered in goo.

A pudgy bipedal Dragon-type Pokemon that appears to be made of goo. It sports a large, spiral-shaped metallic shell on its back, which it can tuck its body into to protect itself, leaving only its head outside of the shell to observe its surroundings.
A quadruped Pokemon similar in appearance to hyenas and canines. It takes a bite at anything that moves, and makes the hair on its tail bristle out to try to intimidate its foes.
A quadruped Pokemon similar to a dinosaur. When its flower is ready to bloom, it gives off a distinct, strong sweet-smelling aroma and starts swelling.
A quadruped Pokemon similar to a goat. Gogoat has the ability to sense the feelings of whoever grips its horns; this ability is so acute that it can move as if it and its rider were one being.

A quadruped Pokemon that is based on a hyena. Mightyena lives in a pack in the wild. As a member of this pack follows the orders of its leader and chases down prey. It gives obvious signals when it is about to attack, as it starts to growl deeply and flattens its body.
A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a Bactrian camel. Its body contains amounts of molten lava of 18,000 F (10,000 C) (27968 U), which erupts out of its humps if the Pokemon is angered.
A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a Dromedary camel. It slows down when wet and cannot stand when it is hungry. Due to its dull wits, it does not notice when it has been hit.
A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a pupal stage. Inside the shell, its body is busy forming for its next evolution. The moment this Pokemon evolves, its shell peels away.
A quadruped Pokemon with sloth-like qualities. Slakoth lolls around and sleeps for more than twenty hours a day, which can makes those around it drowsy.

A quadruped Pokemon with two heads. Its heads dislike each other and are very hostile. As a result, the heads often turn eating into a competition. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
A quadruped Pokemon. Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. It uses this ore to make its body.

A quadruped Pokemon. Nidorina is a gentle Pokemon, known to be a caring mother that chews food for its young. It seems to display close family bonds with others of its kind, and becomes nervous when separated.
A quadruped Pokemon. Nidorino is independent and fierce, often described as violent and easily angered.
A quadruped canine Pokemon. Houndour is an intelligent Pokemon that forms packs to hunt for prey, and shows unparalleled teamwork.
A quadruped canine Pokemon. In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply towards the back serves a leadership role. Leadership is determined by fights within the pack.
A quadruped fox-like Pokemon. Fennekin chews on twigs instead of eating snacks. It can be temperamental, but it tries to do its best for its Trainer.

A quadruped mythical Pokemon. Volcanion has a unique organ capable of turning water vapor around it into hot steam in an instant. It can expel steam of superbly high pressure and has the ability to blow away mountains.
A quadruped pig-like Pokemon. Tepig will roast berries before eating them, but occasionally gets overexcited and burns them.
A quadruped turtle Pokemon. Grotle has the ability to sense where pure water wells up, and will carry other Pokemon on its back to these sources.
A quadruped, bovine Pokemon. A territorial Pokemon, it will headbutt anyone that attempts to invade its territory.

A quadruped, bovine Pokemon. Tauros is a violent, rowdy Pokemon that whips itself into a frenzy using its three tails. Once it starts charging, it is unable to stop or change course until it hits something.
A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Arcanine is a fiercely brave and loyal Pokemon. It is capable of running 6,200 miles (10,000 kilometers) in 24 hours with a speed and grace reminiscent of flight.
A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Boltund can channel the electricity that it generates to its legs in order to keep them strong, boosting its strength and allowing it to run nonstop for three full days.

A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Despite how deceivingly bulky Hisuian Arcanine is, it moves around nimbly like a dancer. This allows it to lead opponents in a merry chase while avoiding them at the same time.
A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Growlithe is a friendly and loyal Pokemon that will fearlessly defend its Trainer and territory from harm, even against larger, stronger enemies.
A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Hisuian Growlithe's soft and insulated fur allows it to survive the cold weather. Growlithe rarely uses its horn unless needed due to it being easily broken.
A quadruped, canine Pokemon. This Pokemon is very sociable and will greet others by rubbing them with the rocks around its neck.

A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Yamper tends to be drawn to fast-moving things and will chase after people, other Pokemon, or even vehicles. Yamper has an organ that generates electricity from the base of its tail when it runs.

A quadruped, caribou-like Pokemon. Stantler can distort reality and create illusions with its antlers by subtly changing the flow of air around them. Staring into them creates an odd sensation, as if one is being sucked through them, and one may become so dizzy that it is impossible to stand.
A quadruped, chimeric Pokemon identical to that of its pre-evolution. The destruction of its mask activates its RKS System, allowing it to change its type according to the Memory attached to it.

A quadruped, chimeric Pokemon with traits from a variety of animals. Type Null was created to be an anti-UB Fighting life-form. Codenamed "Beast Killer", Type Null was given cells taken from all known Pokemon types with the intention of giving it the ability to shift between types by holding a corresponding Memory.
A quadruped, colt-like mythical Pokemon. Keldeo tends to cross the world, and often appears at beautiful watersides. It can walk across water by ejecting water from its hooves.
A quadruped, dinosaurian Pokemon similar to sauropods. Amaura is a calm creature that lived long ago in a cold land without violent predators.

A quadruped, dinosaurian Pokemon that is similar to sauropods. Crystals produce freezing air reaching temperatures of -240 F (-151 C) (9728 U). Aurorus uses this ability to create ice walls for protection.
A quadruped, draconic Pokemon. If enraged, it loses all sense of self and flies into an uncontrollable rampage, destroying everything around it until it tires itself out.
A quadruped, equine Pokemon resembling a small donkey. This Pokemon boasts immense strength for its size, and is able to drag or carry loads up to 50 times its own weight.
A quadruped, feline Pokemon resembling a lion cub or lynx kitten. Electricity is produced by the extension and contraction of muscles in this Pokemon's forelegs.
A quadruped, feline Pokemon. Delcatty is happy most of the time and rarely gets involved in conflicts. When it is disturbed, it just moves to another area instead of fighting.
A quadruped, feline Pokemon. In battle, its tuft of fur radiates heat, and when up against a strong opponent, the temperature increases.
A quadruped, feline Pokemon. The bell-like organ is actually a flame sac. Based on this Pokemon's emotions, the temperature of the bell will rise and eventually it will spit flames.
A quadruped, feline Pokemon. While grooming, it collects fur inside its stomach. By setting the stored fur alight, it can spit fireballs that change based on how it coughs.
A quadruped, frog-like Pokemon. Froakie is both light and strong, making it capable of jumping incredibly high.

A quadruped, hippo-like Pokemon. Hippopotas spends its time bathing in sand and avoids water at all costs. It covers itself in sand as a protective measure against germs and expels sand instead of sweat.
A quadruped, leonine Pokemon. Pyroar live in prides, led by the male with the largest mane of fire, and the females protect the prides cubs.

A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon with a sleek body and slender legs. It hides in the darkness while waiting for its opponents, and its rings glow when it leaps to attack. It is also capable of spraying a poisonous sweat whenever it gets agitated.
A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon with slender legs and dainty paws. The gem embedded in its forehead boosts the psychic powers that it gained to protect its Trainer from harm.

A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles. It is also able to create small ice crystals around it by controlling its body temperature.
A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Its feelers send a soothing aura to calm fights, and will also use them to "hold hands" with its Trainer.
A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Jolteon's fur amplifies the electrical charges produced by its cells. It can also store and generate negative ions in its fur, which create a sparking noise.
A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Using its horn, it is able to sense even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict when a natural disaster will occur.

A quadruped, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Raikou. It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur, and it is rumored that Raging Bolt does this by covering the skies with dark clouds before using its neck to strike down targets with crashing lighting.

A quadruped, sea lion-like Pokemon. Hisuian Samurott is said to have a cold and hard-hearted nature, and is deft with its shell blades. Unlike its Unovan counterpart, which prefers fighting fair, Hisuian Samurott will do anything to win a battle, and prefers to use tricks such as surprise attacks and cheap shots.

A quadruped, sea lion-like Pokemon. When in battle, Samurott can stand on its hind legs and use one of its blades as a sword to fight. In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.

A quadruped, tiger-like legendary Pokemon. Raikou tends to appear during thunderstorms and when other Electric-type Pokemon are in danger. Raikou races across grasslands while barking cries that sound like thunder.

A quadrupedal Pokemon composed of rock salt. Naclstack attacks by pressing the rock salt inside its body into hardened pellets, which it then shoots out with enough force to puncture an iron sheet. Naclstack also uses its salt to dry out and cure its prey.
A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a fully-grown lion. Luxray has powerful eyesight that is capable of seeing through most objects and walls, like x-ray vision.
A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a hog. Its body is surrounded by a floral aroma that calms nearby Pokemon. The female Oinkologne enjoys keeping things tidy, taking a meticulous approach to it.
A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a hog. Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

A quadrupedal Pokemon with a spherical body. A mysterious life-form resembling Donphan. Iron Treads is said to have a cruel nature. It is capable of swiftly curling up its body and rolling like a wheel to attack. The trails it leaves behind are described as similar to scorched earth.
A quadrupedal canine Pokemon. Greavard is friendly, affectionate and easily gets lonely. It is really easy to befriend, and will forever follow anyone who gives it the slightest of attention.
A quadrupedal feline Pokemon. Sprigatito can rub its paws together to unleash a sweet, therapeutic aroma that mesmerizes anyone near it and causes its foes to stop battling.

A quadrupedal giraffine Pokemon. Farigiraf's two brains are connected through thick nerves, allowing it to increase its psychic energy and unleash psychic waves through its antennae. The increased psychic power is 10 times stronger than that of Girafarig.
A quadrupedal legendary Pokemon that possesses traits of stags and goats. Cobalion has a composed demeanor, but dislikes humans. Its glare can make even an unruly Pokemon obey it.

A quadrupedal, amphibious Pokemon. On top of Clodsire's back are six light purple circular spots. If Clodsire is attacked, it will retaliate by sticking out large, thick, light purple spines from these spots ΓÇö a dangerous and risky move.
A quadrupedal, canine Pokemon. Maschiff always tilts its head and makes a big scowl to appear threatening, although the display is highly ineffective even towards children.

A quadrupedal, draconic Pokemon. A mysterious life-form similar to Salamence when they undergo Mega Evolution. Roaring Moon scatters feathers as it flies around at high speeds seeking prey and is more savage than Salamence.
A quadrupedal, goat-like Pokemon. Due to its close relationship with humans, Skiddo has developed the ability to read the feelings of its riders through their grip on its horns.

A quadrupedal, lizard-like Baby Pokemon. Toxel has a poison sac which it uses to store its poison and secretes the same poison through its skin. By manipulating the chemical makeup of this poison, it can produce electricity.

A quadrupedal, stag-like cervine legendary Pokemon. Xerneas has the power to share eternal life; this occurs as the horns on its head shine in seven colors. When Xerneas is at the end of its life, it releases all of its life energy into all the living things in around it and transforms into a tree to sleep for 1,000 years.
A rabbit-like Pokemon. A warm-up of running can cause the fire energy in Scorbunny to start coursing through its body. When this occurs, Scorbunny will be able to fight at full power.
A raccoon-like quadruped Pokemon. They enjoy battling to the point they often attempt to provoke others into fighting it.
A raccoon-like quadruped Pokemon. Zigzagoon is abundantly curious, as it wanders restlessly back and forth while rubbing its nose to the ground in search of something.
A raptor-like avian Pokemon. Pidgeotto is a powerful flier capable of carrying prey several miles to its nest.

A relatively tall bipedal Pokemon resembling a fox. Delphox carries a stick that it uses like a magic wand; when in use, the tip is set alight, and when not in use, the stick is hidden away in its sleeve-like fur.

A reptilian Pokemon resembling a lizard. When carrying a human, Cyclizar can reach a speed of over 70 mph (120 km/h). Cyclizar maintains its balance and absorbs shock while running by using its hard head and thick yet supple tail.

A reptilian Pokemon. The membrane surrounding its eyes protects them from sandstorms and acts as a thermal detector. This allows Krokorok to see the temperature of different objects, which also gives it exceptional night vision.
A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon with large, membranous wings. With its impressive wings, Aerodactyl fearlessly soars high in the skies, freely letting out its high-pitched cries.
A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon. It is capable of leaping freely from branch to branch. While it has the ability to slice down thick trees, it is known to care lovingly for the plants in the forest.

A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon. Krookodile's jaws are extremely powerful, giving it the ability to crush objects as large and durable as an automobile. These features are topped by Krookodile's extremely violent temper.

A rhinoceros-like Pokemon. Rhyhorn's brain is very small, giving it a one-track mind. When it runs, it forgets why it started and continues until it falls asleep. However, it may recall the reason upon demolishing something.

A robotic Pokemon with a body composed of three units. A mysterious life-form that resembles an ancient version of Magnemite. Some scientists claim that Sandy Shocks is a Magneton that has lived for 10,000 years and is said to have an aggressive disposition.
A robotic Pokemon. Beldum's body lacks blood, and is instead powered by a magnetic force. It uses magnetism to move, communicate, and control its attacks.

A robotic Pokemon. Metagross is the result of two Metang fusing together. This gives Metagross four brains in total, all connected by a complex network of neurons. Because of these complex connections and the number of brains, this Pokemon is capable of complex calculations and is more intelligent than a supercomputer.

A robotic Pokemon. Metang is formed when two Beldum fuse together. A magnetic nervous system joins the brains of these two Pokemon. This linkage allows Metang to generate a strong, psychokinetic power.
A robotic moth like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Volcarona. Some point to Iron Moth's aggression as evidence supporting that it may be a UFO controlled by alien life.
A rock Pokemon with a crescent moon shape. The moon increases its power, and its health is tied to the lunar phases.
A rock Pokemon. It has three small objects on its sides and back, called Mini-Noses, which it is able to control. With these Mini-Noses, it is able to attack opponents from all three directions.
A rock-like Pokemon. Its orange crystal is the hardened form of its endlessly leaking energy. The crystal shines brightly when its power rises.

A rock-like, quadruped Pokemon. It compresses energy in the core inside its body that is enough to blow away mountains. It can also store sunlight in its orange crystals and shoot powerful energy from its mouth.
A rodent-like Pokemon resembling a flying squirrel. It can use its flaps to glide from tree to tree, and it can discharge electricity while gliding.
A rodent-like Pokemon that resembles a chipmunk. Patrat is very conscious and wary regarding its surroundings and is always on guard.
A rodent-like Pokemon. Despite its stout body, this Pokemon can be agile and is not easily perturbed.
A rotund Pokemon with a long tongue. It has a big appetite. It can lick anything or anyone close by for any leftover crumbs.
A rotund feline Pokemon. It barges into the nests of other Pokemon and frighten them off so Purugly can claim the nest as its own.
A roughly spherical Pokemon. Its body houses an energy core; due to compression underground, both this core and Roggenrola's body are as hard as steel.
A roughly spherical elephantine Pokemon. It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
A round Pokemon inside of a cloak of leaves. Swadloon lives on the forest floor and converts fallen leaves into nourishment, which helps the surrounding plant life grow.
A round Pokemon resembling a reverse-colored Poke Ball. Electrode explodes in response to even the smallest stimulation, simply to entertain itself, or because it has taken in too much electricity.

A round Pokemon resembling a reverse-colored Poke Ball. When enraged, Hisuian Electrode can unleash a electric current equivalent to about 20 lightning bolts. It can also absorb and store chlorophyll energy along with electricity.
A round Pokemon surrounded by a gel-like substance. It uses psychic powers to communicate with telepathy, as well as to drive away potential threats.
A round Pokemon with the top of its head resembling a club. Bonsly is a good mimic, making it often mistaken for a real bonsai tree. It can remain in the same spot for a long time.

A round Pokemon. Jigglypuff uses its eyes to mesmerize opponents. Once it achieves this, it will inflate its lungs and begin to sing a soothing lullaby. If the opponent resists falling asleep, Jigglypuff will endanger its own life by continuing to sing until its lungs run out of air.
A round Pokemon. Jumpluff drifts on seasonal winds and can use its spores to masterfully maneuver itself around the globe.
A round Pokemon. The fire that burned within their bodies went out, leaving an organ that produces cold air instead. The colder Galarian Darumaka gets, the more energetic it becomes.
A round Pokemon. Venonat's highly developed eyes help it find suitable prey and can shoot powerful beams.
A round Pokemon. When the flame inside its body burns, Darumaka is very active. It cannot calm down in this state, and thus becomes uncontrollable. As the flame shrinks, it falls asleep.

A round cetacean Pokemon. Cetoddle is thought to be a close relative of Wailmer. However, unlike Wailmer, who once lived on land before becoming a sea-dwelling species, Cetoddle used to live in the ocean a long time ago, before it migrated onto land.
A round plant Pokemon. It floats in the air to try to get closer to the sun, but closes its flower and immediately hides under the shade of a tree when it rains.
A round, amorphous Pokemon. It swallows anything of its own size whole, since its stomach comprises most of its body. The unique stomach acid it has allows it to digest almost anything.
A round, bipedal Pokemon. When it senses danger, it spews an acidic liquid from its mouth. It targets Shelmet, so it can evolve.
A round, mouse Pokemon. It can be seen bouncing and playing on its rubbery tail. The tail can also be spun around like a lasso. When the tail is thrown, the body can go as far as 33 feet (10 meters).

A round, owl-like bird Pokemon. Inside Hoothoot's body lies a special organ that senses Earth's rotation, allowing it to keep track of time. Hoothoot is well known for its ability to keep rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time, much like a metronome.
A round, tadpole-like Pokemon. It has two ringed half-spheres on either side of its head. These spheres are vibrated to create a sound too high-pitched for humans to hear.
A round-bodied Pokemon. Elekid tends to play out in the middle of thunderstorms. By rotating its arms, it generates electricity. However, it tires easily and can only charge a small amount.
A rounded, bipedal Pokemon that has a tapir-like trunk. Dream Mist seeps out of the mark on its forehead. This mist has various colors depending on what kind of dreams Musharna has eaten.

A rounded, digital Pokemon that shows similarities to a drinking bird. It is artificially intelligent, and is capable of learning new behaviors on its own. As a result, it will sometimes perform motions or abilities that are not in its programming.

A sauropod-like Pokemon. It is said that Meganium's petals can release an aroma that can soothe anyone that comes in contact with it and can calm aggressive feelings, and its breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants.

A sea star-like Pokemon. Many will float from the seafloor to the surface and align themselves with stars of the night sky as their core flickers, displaying a connection with the celestial bodies of space.
A sea star-like Pokemon. The multi-color glowing of its core is believed to be a method of communication inside the species. However, Starmie's core is most commonly seen as red in color.
A seahorse-like Pokemon. It catches its prey by spinning its body to create large whirlpools. When its prey is exhausted, Seadra swallows it whole using its long snout.

A seed-like Pokemon with a small sprout growing out of its top. Sunkern is known to be very weak. Aware of its weakness, it only feeds until it evolves. However, it feeds on only the dew from under the leaves of plants.
A seemingly robotic life form. The magnetic units on Magnemite's body create electromagnetic waves that allow it to defy gravity and can potentially disrupt electrical equipment.
A serpent Pokemon. Sandaconda uses its inflated sand pouch to protect its head from harm. The pouch can store up to 220 pounds of sand for a time.
A serpent like Pokemon. With a vengeful nature, it will not give up a chase once it targets its prey or an opponent, no matter how far.

A serpentine Chinese dragon-like Pokemon. Its fangs can crush stones and its scales are harder than steel. Gyarados is infamously known for its fierce temper and wanton destructive tendencies, and is attracted to violence.
A serpentine Pokemon similar to a Chinese dragon. It loves communicating with people and Pokemon, and is especially gentle with children. It will often appear in areas where children gather.

A serpentine Pokemon that is usually depicted scrunched up like an accordion. Seviper wraps around its opponents to make them unable to move. Its tail and fangs are venomous, and are used for striking and poisoning prey or enemies.

A serpentine Pokemon with a drill-like tail. Though Dunsparce can float slightly with its wings, it avoids detection by burrowing into the ground with its tail. It lives immobile in caves and beneath the earth, where it makes maze-like nests.

A serpentine Pokemon. As Dratini is filled with life energy, it is constantly growing, and can thus reach lengths of over six feet. As it grows, it sheds its skin regularly. Whenever Dratini undergoes shedding, it hides behind a large waterfall.
A serpentine Pokemon. By flicking its tongue out, it is able to detect danger and the scent of prey.
A serpentine Pokemon. Dudunsparce makes its nest, which can reach over six miles (10 km) long, by using its hard tail to bore holes into bedrock deep underground.
A serpentine Pokemon. Its pointed mouth is used to stab prey and drain their body fluids. However, it has also been known to feed on seaweed that grows between stones.
A serpentine Pokemon. Serperior will only attack with full force against opponents that are unfazed by its piercing glare.

A set of Diglett triplets sharing a single body. Dugtrio's three heads think the same thoughts and act cooperatively. In order to make burrowing easier, each head will bob up and down to loosen the soil.
A shabby, old-looking fish-like Pokemon. While there are many of this Pokemon in existence, populations tend to cluster in small areas.

A shadow-like Pokemon holding a mask that has a face from its time as a human. Due to being a human long ago, it has memories of being a human. If someone wears the mask Yamask carries, they will become possessed by the Yamask in question.
A shadow-like Pokemon holding a tablet. The tablet bears cursed engravings that resemble a serpent's tail and is said to absorb Yamask's dark power.
A shadow-like mythical Pokemon. Darkrai is known to "inhabit" dreams and causes the target to have unending nightmares, which can be stopped if exposed to a Lunar Wing from Cresselia.
A sheep-like Pokemon. Dubwool's wool is very springy. Its horns serve the purpose of attracting the opposite gender rather than being used in battles.
A sheep-like Pokemon. Mareep's wool, which grows continuously, stores electricity, rubbing together and building a static charge. Touching the wool when it is charged will result in a static shock.

A sheep-like Pokemon. Wooloo have an extremely fluffy body which can serve as a cushion and help it survive even when falling off a cliff, and stand up without injures. The fur grows back quickly in three months even when shaved.

A short primate Pokemon. Grafaiai's saliva is brightly colored and poisonous, and its color changes depending on Grafaiai's diet, which includes Berries and Bug-type Pokemon. Grafaiai uses this poisonous saliva to attack foes, either by spitting the saliva at them or by coating its hands with the saliva before slashing at them.

A short, bipedal Pokemon. It uses its non-threatening appearance to make foes underestimate it, then attacks with its giant jaws; when engaged in battle, Mawile usually has its back turned on the enemy to better use its jaws.
A short, bipedal plant Pokemon. Capsakid creates spicy chemicals inside its body by using energy from sunlight, which it uses to power its moves.
A short, chubby rodent Pokemon. It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

A short, chubby rodent Pokemon. Pikachu has been known to build up energy in its glands, and will need to discharge to avoid complications. It is also able to release energy through its tail, which acts as a grounding rod, as well as recharging fellow Pikachu with electric shocks.
