A short, eel-like Pokemon. A single Tynamo does not generate much power, so groups of Tynamo move in schools and create a more powerful shock.
A short, humanoid Pokemon. It creates its own hammer using iron scraps, remaking it as many times as it wants until it is satisfied. Tinkatink uses the hammer to protect itself.

A short, quadruped Pokemon. It usually burrows under the surface, with only its nose and eyes above the sand. Due to being so close to the surface, it can move around the desert and allow the heat of the sand to regulate its body temperature.
A simian Pokemon with two tails, each with a large, rounded hand with three fingers. Ambipom can leap from tree to tree with brilliant speed. To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails.

A simian Pokemon. Annihilape evolved from Primeape when the rage in its soul became too much for its physical form to contain; it gained increased power as a result of its spirit no longer being limited by the flesh.
A simian Pokemon. Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
A simian Pokemon. Nutrient rich water is stored in its crest and it can keep itself damp or water plants by spraying water from its tail.
A simian Pokemon. Pansage dwells deep in the forest, where it collects berries to share with its friends.
A simian Pokemon. The tuft on its head contains a flame that can reach temperatures of 600 F (315 C) (10568 U).
A simian Pokemon. The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
A simian Pokemon. There is a flame inside its body, which it fuels with sweet foods. It is also capable of scattering embers from its tail and the tufts on its head.
A simian legendary Pokemon. Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
A simian mythical Pokemon resembling a baboon or mandrill. They're usually incredibly aggressive, and frighten most other Pokemon; excelling in battle with their sharp claws and quick wit.
A sleek, bipedal snake or dragon-like legendary Pokemon. Thundurus can shoot thunderbolts from its tail.

A slender tree that stands on six roots bent like spider legs. Trevenant can use its roots as a nervous system, allowing it to control trees at will. It uses this ability to trap those who bring harm to the forest, so they can never leave.
A slender, feline Pokemon. Liepard has well-developed muscles that allows it to run silently and strike opponents from behind. It has also been known to vanish and reappear without warning.
A slender-bodied, quadruped Pokemon. It prefers recklessly challenging opponents that are stronger than itself. Linoone is known to use its long tongue to taunt opponents.
A slender-bodied, quadruped Pokemon. Linoone has an attraction to anything round, and will grab any orb-shaped object it sees if given the chance.

A slightly humanoid Pokemon with a few feline traits. Electabuzz is capable of storing huge amounts of electrical energy inside of its body over long periods. During torrential thunderstorms, Electabuzz will compete to determine which is capable of attaining the highest ground, so as to be most likely struck by a bolt of lightning.

A slightly insectoid, bipedal dragon Pokemon. With its wings, it kicks up sandstorms to hide itself. Its wings make a "singing" sound when they are flapped, earning Flygon the name "The Desert Spirit".
A slim bipedal Pokemon. This swift Pokemon hides in thick foliage or shadows to avoid attacks before retaliating.

A slim humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Enamorus's love was said to have given rise to fresh life. However, it's also known to be vengeful to those who disrespect any form of life. It will descend from the clouds and deliver a wrathful, ruthless punishment in the process.
A slim quadruped Pokemon. The fire coming from its head and rear can be launched as a flame attack. It also uses gusts of superheated air as a battle technique.

A slim, bipedal lizard-like Pokemon. Drizzile uses special pores to create water balloons secreted from the moisture in its palms to attack. While it is highly intelligent, Drizzile is exceptionally lazy and prefers to not do anything unless it has to.

A slim, quadruped, mammalian legendary Pokemon. Suicune has the power to walk across water and purify dirty water with one touch. It travels across grasslands in search of water to purify. Northern winds always seem to blow stronger in its presence.
A slimy, amorphous blob-like Pokemon made of living sludge. Grimer is perpetually hungry and must constantly eat trash; if none is readily available, it will eat other manufactured products instead.

A slimy, amorphous blob-like Pokemon made of living sludge. Pieces of it often breaks off during travel, and from these pieces new Grimer will begin to grow. It happily consumes and thrives off nearly any form of waste or refuse.
A sloth-like, bipedal Pokemon. Vigoroth's heart beats at a tenfold tempo, and it cannot sit still for even a minute. Attempting to stand still or sleep raises its stress level and agitates its blood.
A slug-like Pokemon whose appearance changes drastically depending on where it is found. If it is pushed or squeezed, a mysterious purple fluid will ooze out of its body.
A slug-like Pokemon. When it is threatened, it oozes purple fluid and flees.
A small Pokemon resembling a bird chick. Flittle is also known to be quite vengeful. Should anyone steal Flittle's berries, it will chase after them for revenge.
A small Pokemon resembling a key ring with four keys on it. If Klefki finds a key it likes, it will never release it. To threaten attackers, this Pokemon jingles its key collection.
A small Pokemon resembling a mangostee. While fleeing danger, Bounsweet skips along in a way that does not convey its desperation. As a result, no one ever comes to help it.
A small Pokemon resembling a reptile or amphibian. Dreepy are exceptionally weak in combat, so much that on its own, a mere child could defeat it.
A small Pokemon resembling a salamander or lizard. From the base of its tail, Salandit can emit both a toxic gas and flames. The gas has a sweet odor that causes dizziness.
A small Pokemon resembling an olive. Inside its fruit, Smoliv stores oil made from nutrients it gathers through photosynthesis, which allows it to go for a week without eating or drinking.

A small Pokemon similar to a mushroom. It moves around to avoid depriving the plants in any one area of too many nutrients. In addition to locomotion, its roots are also used to make communicate with other Morelull.

A small Pokemon similar to a mushroom. When it senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters toxic spores from the top of its head. These spores can make trees and weeds wilt and cause whole body pain if inhaled.
A small Pokemon similar to a seagull. By extending its wings, it is able to glide across the sky.

A small Pokemon that is shaped like an egg. Happiny's pouch is rubbery and flexible, enabling the Happiny to put things into it with ease. As it cannot produce Eggs yet, it makes up for it by carrying an Egg-shaped stone in its pouch to imitate Chansey and Blissey.
A small Pokemon that is vaguely star-shaped in appearance. It has been known to be attracted by meteor showers, and sightings of this Pokemon always increase during meteor showers.
A small Pokemon that resembles a figurine made out of clay or mud. It moves by spinning on its single, pointed foot, and balance upright on it to sleep.
A small Pokemon that resembles a splash of milk. Milcery is born from sweet smelling particles in the air. It's said that patisseries visited by Milcery are guaranteed success and good fortune.

A small Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Squirtles shell is a useful tool. It can withdraw into the shell for protection or for sleeping, and its grooved, rounded shape helps to reduce water resistance when this Pokemon swims.
A small Pokemon that resembles an acorn. While hanging, this Pokemon absorbs moisture and nutrients from the tree until becomes too heavy and falls to the ground.

A small Pokemon whose body is almost entirely hidden under a veil. Mimikyu's disguise is modelled after Pikachu because of the popularity of Pikachu-styled merchandise. This lonely Pokemon thought that this disguise would allow it to make friends with people.
A small Pokemon with a darker necklace of buds. Aside from the soothing aroma that wafts from its leaf, Chikorita uses its leaf to determine the temperature and humidity of the surrounding air.
A small Pokemon with a gaseous body similar to a nebula. Cosmog has the ability to open Ultra Wormholes, but only when under stress, and this process is very dangerous for Cosmog.

A small Pokemon with a large leaf that resembles a lilypad covering its back. This large leaf allows Lotad to float across ponds, and it will sometimes ferry smaller Pokemon on its back in this manner.
A small Pokemon with a large shell covering its body. Although Kabuto have been found fossilized by way of lying on the ocean floor for millennia, on rare occasions, it has been found still living.
A small Pokemon with a round body that is still encased in its eggshell. It has a very joyful nature. As a result, it is said that it shares its joy with those who take care of it.
A small Pokemon with an ovoid body. Well-adapted to life in colder climates, it subsists on snow and ice and can survive temperatures as low as -150 F (-100 C) (9818 U).

A small Pokemon with several flowers surrounding it. This Pokemon picks flowers to create the ring around itself, and will give these rings to those it likes. The flowers can also be thrown at enemy Pokemon to create an opening to either flee or attack.

A small Pokemon with two different forms. Cherrim waits quietly as a bud for a ray of sunlight. When it is hit with strong sunlight, it blooms and absorbs the rays with its entire body. It quickly changes from quiet to excitable and active.

A small Pokemon. Due to being a bit timid, should Sobble get nervous or embarrassed, it will secrete water from its body like sweat in order to disappear into its surroundings. Sobble's tears can make others cry; the effect is so powerful that its tears are said to be as potent as 100 onions.
A small Pokemon. Hatenna is able to sense other creatures' emotions via the protrusion on its head. It never warms up to anyone that does not have a calm disposition.
A small Pokemon. Mime Jr. has a knack for imitating others; it can easily pick up emotions of those around it and imitate it.
A small Ultra Beast. It cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

A small amphibian Pokemon. Tadbulb can generate and store enough electricity to power cities. It is also capable of using electricity to float in the air; if the weather is stormy, it can float at a higher altitude.
A small amphibious, quadruped Pokemon. By using the fin on its head, Mudkip is able to detect changes in air and water currents as well as bodies of water.
A small avian Pokemon. Rufflet is extremely aggressive and knowingly provokes opponents larger and more powerful than itself. It sees this as a means of quickly getting stronger.
A small bipedal Pokemon. Marill is able to swim in strong water currents without being slowed down by the waters resistance, due to its water-repellent fur.
A small bipedal Pokemon. Roselia's aroma brings serenity, but the thorns on its head contain a vicious poison. The more healthy it is, the more pleasant its flower's aroma.

A small bipedal Pokemon. Whimsicott can manipulate its body to pass through cracks, no matter how narrow. Because of this, Whimsicott is a notorious prankster, moving things and leaving cotton balls behind.
A small bird Pokemon. Taillow is very gutsy, and will stand up to powerful opponents without backing down.
A small bird-like Pokemon. Rookidee are feisty and territorial Pokemon and will bravely fight against anybody, no matter how big and strong that opponent is.

A small blob like mythical Pokemon with a body made of liquid metal. It is a curious and expressive Pokemon. Meltan's liquid arms and legs can corrode and absorb metal into its body, which it uses to generate electricity.

A small candle-like Pokemon. Litwick pretends to guide people and Pokemon around by illuminating darkened areas. However, it is actually sucking away their life energy and leading them to the Ghost World.

A small canine Pokemon. Fidough's smooth, moist skin is firm yet soft to the touch, and has elastic qualities; when agitated, Fidough will puff itself up to appear larger, in an attempt to intimidate its opponents.
A small cephalopod Pokemon. They have the intelligence of a three-year-old human. It is a very curious creature and often investigates things through punching them with its tentacles.
A small cherry-like Pokemon. It has been known to sun bathe on warm days. When it is about to evolve, the second head starts to wilt.
A small chick Pokemon. Somewhere in its belly, this Pokemon has a place where it keeps a flame. This internal flame causes Torchic to feel warm if hugged.
A small fish Pokemon with an ellipsoid body. Because of its wing-like fins, it is known as "The Beautifly of the Sea".
A small fishlike Pokemon. Even though an individual Wishiwashi is small and weak, people still fear it and call it the demon of the sea.
A small hermit crab-like Pokemon. When finding a rock to use as its shell, Dwebble inspects the rock to see if it can be used, then it digs a hole in the rocks bottom.
A small humanoid Pokemon. Hatterene has a solitary and reclusive nature, emitting psychic powers strong enough to cause headaches as a method to deter others from approaching and disturbing it.
A small humanoid Pokemon. Impidimp is a mischievous Pokemon that loves to sneak into people's houses to steal things and generally be a nuisance to their occupants.

A small insectoid Pokemon that resembles three pieces hexagonal honeycomb stuck together. When it is not gathering honey, it sleeps or protects its queen. The former is done by creating a hive along with other Combee, locking together into a "wall" to feel safe in larger numbers.
A small larva Pokemon. Weedle can retaliate against attackers and those who step on it with its strong toxin.
A small mole like Pokemon. Drilbur can straighten its body and align its claws forward, allowing it to spin like a drill and dig through the ground.

A small mythical Pokemon resembling a piece of mochi. It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under PecharuntΓÇÖs control, chained to its will.

A small piscine dragon Pokemon. Although relatively weak, Tatsugiri is one of the most intelligent dragon Pokemon. It baits prey such as bird Pokemon by playing dead. When its prey approaches, Tatsugiri then commands its partner, Dondozo, to attack.
A small quadrupedal Pokemon. As it is blind, it will bite at and eat anything that moves, and it has the vigor and energy to bite constantly and without stopping.
A small round, Pokemon. Hoppip's body is very light, and it is easily lifted off the ground by winds and will drift in the air.
A small sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.

A small sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.

A small, ammonite Pokemon. Several gas-filled chambers exist within Omanyte's shell, which it uses to regulate its buoyancy within the water. By evacuating or filling the chambers, it rises and falls while twisting its tentacles to swim.
A small, aquatic mythical Pokemon. Eighty percent of Manaphy's body is made of water. It is highly susceptible to its environment, and swims long distances to return to its birthplace.
A small, arthropod Pokemon. This Pokemon is cowardly by nature and wary of both noise and sudden movements. However, its curiosity will cause it to approach people or Pokemon that are standing still.
A small, avian Pokemon resembling a young owl. It approaches opponents by silently gliding, before unleashing a volley of kicks.

A small, avian Pokemon similar to a robin. Fletchling are said to be very friendly and are well known for their beautiful songs. They communicate by using chirps and moving their tail-feathers to signal one another.

A small, bearlike legendary Pokemon. Kubfu works hard to train both body and mind, even if it suffers defeat. It has a unique organ that allows it to create "fighting energy" through special deep breathing and intense focusing.

A small, beetle-like Pokemon. Rellor creates its mud ball by mixing dirt and sand with psychic energy. It values its mud ball more than its own life, and rolls it around as the energy needed for it to evolve matures.
A small, bipedal Pokemon that seems to be a composite of features from an echidna and a shrew. Cyndaquil is usually timid by nature and often curls into a ball when intimidated.
A small, bipedal Pokemon with mixed reptilian and avian traits. It is believed to be the ancestor of all bird Pokemon.
A small, bipedal Pokemon. Blades comprise this Pokemon's entire body. When hunting, Pawniard immobilizes prey by repeated stabbing with these blades.
A small, bipedal Pokemon. Cubone will often weep at night in mourning of its mother. When Cubone cries, the skull that it wears on its head vibrates and emits "a plaintive and mournful sound.

A small, bipedal Pokemon. It will test its endurance by squeezing up against other Wynaut at night. In doing so, it strengthens itself, toughens its spirit, and learns to deal powerful counterattacks.
A small, bipedal bird-like Pokemon. Hawlucha makes up for its small body with its proficiency in fighting, which allows it to keep up with bigger fighters such as Machamp and Hariyama.

A small, bipedal canine Pokemon. It is sensitive to a special type of energy called Aura; however, It does not have the ability to fully use these powers, although it can still emanate these waves to communicate and sense them, albeit only in ripples.
A small, bipedal dragon-like Pokemon. It has tremendously strong jaws that it uses to bite enemies. However, when biting, it often hurts itself because of clumsiness.
A small, bipedal reptilian Pokemon. Because of its territorial nature, it is known to be the protector of the forests trees.
A small, bipedal, bird-like Pokemon. Aromatisse can give off a variety of different smells, from a pleasant fragrance to an odor so repugnant to its opponent that it can turn a battle in its favor.

A small, bipedal, feline Pokemon. Its ears are folded and beneath them are two ring-shaped organs. These organs emit Espurr's intense psychic powers, and said power would leak out were the ears not sheltering the organs.
A small, bipedal, rabbit-like Pokemon. It can deliver powerful blows with its curled up ears, and it has an impressive jumping ability.
A small, caterpillar-like Pokemon. Wurmple has suction pads at the tips of its feet, which allow it to cling to glass or tree branches without slipping.
A small, ceratopsian-like reptilian Pokemon. Its facial hide is extremely hard; however, it is vulnerable when attacked from behind.
A small, cicada-like Pokemon. Ninjask is a very fast Pokemon that is said to be able to evade any attack, and was long believed to be invisible due to its high speed.
A small, cuboid Pokemon resembling an insect. Charjabug creates and stores electricity in its body by digesting food. This energy is stored in an electric sac.
A small, elephant-like Pokemon. In the deserted morning hours, Phanpy uses its trunk to shower in the river. Sometimes, groups of this Pokemon form and soak each other thoroughly.
A small, fairy like Pokemon. It flutters around and cares for flowers that are about to wilt; if the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, Floette celebrates with an elegant dance.
A small, fairy like Pokemon. It is seen holding the pistil of a flower, which has petals that come in five colors.

A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Azelf's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. Legends say that if Azelf is harmed, it can cause humans to lose all will inside of them, making them completely immobile for all eternity.

A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Mesprit's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. Legends say that a person that touches it will have their emotions completely drained away.
A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Uxie's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. It created all knowledge in the Pokemon universe.
A small, feline Pokemon. It is known to wander about city streets and pick up anything that sparkles, including loose change.

A small, feline Pokemon. The darker the coin is, the more respect it gets from its peers. Galarian Meowth's body has partially turned to iron as a result of many years of living with a race of savage seafarers.
A small, feline Pokemon. The luxurious royal lifestyle soon led to Meowth diverging from its origins and becoming the selfish and prideful Alolan Meowth.
A small, fluffy Pokemon. It only eats sweets, which makes its fur as sticky as cotton candy.
A small, furry Pokemon. It will not sleep alone, and usually sleeps while another of its kind watches for danger.

A small, ground-dwelling rodent Pokemon. Pichu is a social Pokemon known for its playful and mischievous demeanor. It is usually found in groups and often touch tails with other Pichu as a show of courage, creating a shower of sparks that can make them cry.

A small, hedgehog-like mythical Pokemon. Each season, Shaymin gathers with others in a flower field somewhere and migrates from there. This behavior is called Flower Carrying because a new field of flowers grow where it lands.
A small, humanoid Pokemon that resembles a baby. Being very conscious of its appearance, it will check is reflection when given the chance to make sure it is not dirty.
A small, humanoid Pokemon. Gothita intently observes those around it, and can become unaware of attacks.
A small, humanoid Ultra Beast that resembles origami. Despite its small size compared to the other Ultra Beasts, Kartana is extremely dangerous, as every edge of its body is impossibly sharp.

A small, humanoid mythical Pokemon. Jirachi hibernates for extensive periods, forming a protective crystalline shell as it sleeps. However, it is still capable of fighting while asleep if it is in danger.

A small, insectoid Pokemon. If threatened by a bird Pokemon, it can spew a powder that paralyzes on contact. The powder covering its body regulates its temperature, allowing it to adapt to any climate.
A small, insectoid Pokemon. In order to defend itself, Spewpa will bristle its fur to threaten predators or spray powder at them.
A small, insectoid Pokemon. It uses its jaw as a weapon, a tool for burrowing, and for extracting sap from trees.
A small, insectoid Pokemon. Its claws are used to carve the roots of tree and absorb moisture and nutrients.

A small, larval Pokemon. Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak. The cloak protects it from the cold, and will become thinner when the weather is hot.
A small, larval Pokemon. Snom anchors itself to branches with frigid thread it extrudes from its mouth to disguise itself as an icicle while sleeping.
A small, lizard-like Pokemon. Helioptile can generate its own energy from sunlight, so it can thrive without food; it will still eat if needed.
A small, plant like Pokemon. The pollen it produces has a healing effect, and it can be made into a tea as a common folk remedy given to sick children.
A small, plant-like Pokemon. If anything bothers it while it is gathering sunlight, Fomantis will fiercely attack it.
A small, plump-bodied avian Pokemon. Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction and homing instincts. It can locate its nest even when far removed from familiar surroundings.
A small, quadruped Pokemon resembling a round ice chunk. Bergmite can summon air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its opponents solid.

A small, quadruped Pokemon resembling a turtle or tortoise. As a plant-based Pokemon, Turtwig usually nourishes itself through photosynthesis. It also drinks water, which hardens its soil-based shell.

A small, quadruped Pokemon similar to a dinosaur. While Jangmo-o trains diligently and remains humble, it has the pride of a warrior. It employs the scale on its forehead for both attack and defense, so it never shows its back to its foe.

A small, quadruped Pokemon. On its back is a green plant bulb, which is grown from a seed planted there at birth. The bulb provides it with energy through photosynthesis as well as from the nutrient-rich seeds contained within.
A small, quadruped rodent Pokemon. Alolan Rattata search out fresh food by smell, and ignore anything spoiled.
A small, quadruped rodent Pokemon. Thanks to its sharp fangs, it is able to eat nearly anything. When it is threatened, Rattata can deliver a powerful bite.

A small, quadruped, fox-like Pokemon. Alolan Vulpix can expel breath as cold as -58 F (-50 C) (9918 U), which is capable of freezing anything. While it is not suited to warmer environments, its tail can produce ice to lower the surrounding temperature if needed.
A small, quadruped, fox-like Pokemon. Vulpix has a flame inside its body that never goes out, and is capable of manipulating fire to such precision as to create floating wisps of flame.

A small, quadruped, rodent-like Pokemon. Nidoran constantly listens for the sounds of approaching enemies with its large ears. Said ears have unique muscles that allow them to be moved in any direction, and even the slightest sound does not escape Nidorans notice.
A small, quadruped, rodent-like Pokemon. The poison secreted by the spines and horn is extremely potent, and even a scratch from its horn or a drop of poison from its barbs can be deadly.

A small, quadrupedal, rodent Pokemon. Pawmi has yellow underdeveloped electric sacs in its cheeks, as well as yellow pad-like organs on its forepaws that can discharge electricity. If it feels threatened, it will rub its cheeks to generate electricity, which it then delivers to its opponents by touching them with its forepaws.
A small, rabbit-like Pokemon. Bunnelby's ears are strong enough to shovel dirt and chop tree roots.
A small, rabbit-like mythical Pokemon. Victini is said to bring victory to the Trainer that befriends it. It produces an infinite amount of energy within itself and can share it with others by touch.

A small, reptilian Pokemon with rocky skin. Larvitar is born deep underground, far from its parent. It grows by consuming soil, and will enter its pupal stage upon eating an entire mountains worth of earth.
A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. In this form, Terapagos resembles the world as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy is abnormally amplified.
A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals.
A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.
A small, round Pokemon with a body shaped like a furin wind chime. Chimecho can create ultrasonic sound waves and other noises. It uses seven different echoing cries to communicate with others.
A small, round, fish-like Pokemon. Chinchou charges up its electric attacks by absorbing energy through its two antennae, and flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
A small, round, mouse-like Pokemon. Its tail can absorb electricity from power plants or house outlets. It can then fire electricity from its whiskers.

A small, roundish Pokemon with branch-like growths on its back similar to coral. Corsola requires clean water to live. If its habitat is dirty, the growths on its back become discolored and degenerate.

A small, seahorse-like Pokemon. It is highly adept in the water, using its dorsal fin to swim in any direction while facing forward. It can use its tail as both a balance and an anchor when caught in a strong current.

A small, serpentine Pokemon that resembles a loach. A slimy film covers it and protects it from bacteria and allows it to get away easily when grabbed. If it does not stay moist, it dries up and weakens.

A small, skunk-like Pokemon. Stunky can spray a foul-smelling liquid from its rear in order to drive attackers away. The stench can be smelled from over a mile away, and will linger for around 24 hours.
A small, squirrel-like Pokemon. When it sleeps, Pachirisu likes to curl its big, fluffy tail round to the front of its body and uses it as a pillow. It also likes to chase and groom its tail.
A small, tick like Pokemon. Joltik is too small to generate its own electricity, so it attaches itself to larger Pokemon and feeds off their static electricity.
A small, vaguely humanoid Pokemon. Hattrem makes use of its ponytails as hands, pummeling its foes with them. One blow from these ponytails would knock out a professional boxer.

A small, worm-like Pokemon. As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple, which serves as a home, food source, and protection against preying bird Pokemon. The flavor of the apple determines which evolution Applin will evolve into.
A snail-like Pokemon. It closes the lid on its helmet-like shell as a defensive tactic, and can spit a poisonous sticky fluid.
A snail-like legendary Pokemon. Wo-Chien is able to drain the life force of vegetations in a wide area around it, causing entire forests and fields to instantly become barren.

A snow deer-like Pokemon. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing. By using the orbs on its antlers, Wyrdeer can unleash psychic powers strong enough to distort space, and also create invisible barriers for protection.
A somewhat plant-like Pokemon. Its tentacles are waved around to attract prey, which is swallowed whole after being entangled.
A specter Pokemon which possesses a teapot. It is made of black tea that tastes very good, but can cause indigestion or stomach aches if drunk in excess.

A specter Pokemon which possesses a teapot. It is made of black tea that tastes very good, but can cause indigestion or stomach aches if drunk in excess. Most of the teapots that Polteageist infects are forgeries.

A spherical Pokemon filled with toxic gasses. Koffing creates gases within its body by mixing toxins with garbage, and produces more gas in higher temperatures. These gases are malodorous and cause sniffles, coughs, and teary eyes to those around it.

A spherical Pokemon similar to a bell. Inside its mouth is an orb, which creates a ringing sound as the Pokemon moves. Additionally, the orb can be vibrated to create high frequency, long lasting cries to deafen its opponents.

A spherical Pokemon that appears to be covered by a gray cloth. Its horn collects the negative emotions of people, on which this Pokemon feeds. The emotions it feeds on include anger, jealousy, and envy.

A spherical Pokemon that consists of a rock core covered by ice. Its icy body will not melt, and it can control ice by freezing moisture in the air. This ability is used to freeze its opponents, which it then consumes.
A spherical Pokemon that looks like a Poke Ball with a face, minus the button. It has a volatile temperament, and will explode if bumped or agitated.
A spherical Pokemon that looks like a Poke Ball with a face, minus the latch. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

A spherical Pokemon, resembling a Honduran White Bat. Woobat's nose serves various purposes. It uses ultrasonic waves from its nostrils for echolocation, and it can also be used to grip walls as Woobat sleeps, which leaves heart-shaped marks on the walls of caves.

A spherical Pokemon. Sigilyph will use its psychic powers to attack anyone who invades its territory. Due to it retaining memories from when it guarded an ancient city, it apparently flies along the same route constantly.
A spherical Pokemon. While it is always expressionless, it is able to sense the emotions and thoughts of others.
A spherical whale Pokemon with no tail. When storing water in its body, it can turn into a bouncing ball. The more water filling its body, the higher it can bounce.

A spherical, bull-like legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Terrakion. Iron Boulder stores laser energy within its sharp horns. Iron Boulder uses the charged energy within its axe horns to plow through anything within Iron Boulder's path.

A spherical, golem-like legendary Pokemon. Due to its body being formed by crystallized dragon energy, Regidrago is said to have the most powerful Dragon-type moves of all Pokemon. It also has the power of every Dragon-type Pokemon.

A spherical, rodent-like Pokemon. Togedemaru uses the needle on top of its head to attract and gather electricity. Groups can be seen gathered with their needles standing upright, waiting to be struck by lightning on stormy days.
A spirit possessing a rotten tree stump. People that happen to enter the forest may be led astray by Phantump, as they are capable of imitating the sound of childrens voices.
A squat ape-like Pokemon. The snowball on its head serves as a way of preserving food and other things it finds by storing them in the snowball itself.
A squat ape-like Pokemon. When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
A squat quadruped Pokemon. Venusaur uses its flower to catch the suns rays to convert them into energy, which causes the flower to take on colors that are more vibrant.
A squid-like Pokemon. It can lure prey with hypnotic motions before it wraps its tentacles around the prey, then it finishes off with digestive fluids.
A squid-like Pokemon. Those who stare into its yellow lights become dazed and lose their will to battle, allowing Inkay to escape.

A squirrel-like Pokemon. Using its special cheeks, Skwovet can stuff a tremendous amount of food and can stretch to many times its normal volume. When they are not eating berries, they spit out the seeds in the rich soil in order to cultivate berry trees.
A stag or antelope-like, mechanical, quadruped legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Virizion. It has glowing parts on its forehead and neck can transform into ethereal swords.
A stag or antelope-like, quadruped legendary Pokemon. Its horns are as sharp as blades, and are used to cut opponents.
A starfish-like Pokemon with a stalk-like body. Mareanie is known to actively hunt and prey on Corsola. Its main tactic is to harass it until the Corsola sheds its horns.
A stocky, armored, Pokemon. Lairon smashes its steely body against others in battle over territory, and shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming into rocks.
A stout Pokemon resembling a hog. Lechonk has an excellent sense of smell, which it uses to find fragrant wild grasses and rich Berries to eat.
A stout, bipedal, reptilian Pokemon. Frigibax stores the ice energy inside its body and uses it to cool its dwelling. It stores more ice energy the greater its surrounding temperatures are.
A stout, bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. Although Pawmot's reaction speed is normally low, it is able to strike opponents with fast movements when battling.
A stout, bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. When attacked, Pawmo will be the first to fight back, defeating foes with its electricity.
A stout, canine Pokemon. Dachsbun's body emanates a pleasant, appetizing aroma, which helps wheat to grow; thus, Dachsbun is historically treasured by farming villages.
A super sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.

A super sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.

A swan-like Pokemon. Swanna is known to fly for thousands of miles without rest. Swanna flies out when the sun rises. At dusk, flocks of Swanna will dance, with the leader in the middle of the routine.
A swan-like legendary Pokemon. Cresselia has the power to dispel nightmares, and holding one of its feathers is said to bring happy dreams.
A sylph-like mythical Pokemon. It can instantly create diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air; these diamonds can then be used to defend itself.

A tall Pokemon resembling Stonehenge. Occasionally, it will unleash a burst of speed to perform dynamic feats with its legs. Most of the time, it stands in a field watching the sun's progress, preferring a quiet life.
A tall Pokemon with a soft body. Wobbuffet is usually a docile Pokemon that will never attack first. However, when it is attacked, it will inflate its body and initiate a counterstrike.

A tall Pokemon with a vaguely star-shaped body. Clefable is a timid creature that flees when it senses people approaching, and is one of the worlds rarest Pokemon. Its sensitive ears can distinctly hear a pin drop from half a mile (one kilometer) away.
A tall bipedal Pokemon. The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokemon has considerable agility.

A tall flightless avian Pokemon resembling an ostrich. Espathra is able to emit psychic powers from its eyes and the gaps between its frills. By using the psychic powers emitted from its eyes, it can immobilize foes.
A tall, amorphous Pokemon. It is capable of swallowing anything whole, and can digest anything except its own stomach lining.

A tall, avian Pokemon that resembles an owl. It takes only a tenth of a second for it pluck, aim, and fire an arrow quill from its wings. It is not only quick, but also accurate, capable of striking targets over half a mile away.

A tall, avian Pokemon that resembles an owl. It tends to have a nomadic lifestyle, wandering the region in search of food. Its legs can deliver powerful kicks that can knock down trees and destroy boulders.
A tall, bipedal Pokemon that resemble a palm tree. Each head thinks independently of the others, so it makes a lot of noise as each head speaks its mind.
A tall, bipedal Pokemon that strongly resembles a coconut palm or other palm tree. Each head thinks independently of the others, so it makes a lot of noise as each head speaks its mind.

A tall, metallic, bipedal dinosaur-like Pokemon. When Archaludon faces danger, it will get down on all fours, straighten its body, retract its limbs, and fully extend the spires on its hands and feet, forming a shape that resembles a steel bridge. In this position, Archaludon is capable of using the static electricity stored in its terminals to fire a tremendously powerful beam of electric energy.
A theropod-like Pokemon. Arctibax has strong back and leg muscles, which allow it to do a front flip while airborne and attack opponents with its dorsal fin.
A thin bipedal, insectoid Pokemon. It is very parental and uses its cutters and a sticky silk it produces to create clothing made of leaves for small Pokemon.
A three-headed, draconic Pokemon. Hydreigon is a violent, destructive Pokemon. It will attack anything that moves, determining it a foe.
A three-headed, mechanical, draconic Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Hydreigon. It combines Hydreigon's ferocity with the ruthlessness of a machine.
A tiny Pokemon that seems to be perpetually buried within the earth. Diglett digs regularly through the earth at a shallow depth, leaving perfectly tilled soil in its wake.

A tiny avian Pokemon. Wattrel flies in a specific way so that its wings are able to catch the wind. Its bones, in reaction to the wind, create electricity for Wattrel, and it uses this ability to dive into bodies of water to electrocute its prey, such as Arrokuda.

A tiny insect Pokemon. Cutiefly is capable of detecting the aura of living things, such as plants, people, and Pokemon. It collects nectar and pollen from flowers, which are found by the color and brightness of their auras.
A tiny insectoid Pokemon. Ribombee uses its fluffy hair to hold pollen it collects from flowers. Rain causes its hair to become dirty, so it only visits fields if the weather will remain clear.
A tiny shrew-like Pokemon. Shroodle has a mellow personality, but if angered, it will bite into the offender, inflicting them with its venom.
A tiny, bird Pokemon with a nearly spherical body. It has the quirky behavior of staring at something until the thing moves.

A tortoise-like, quadruped Pokemon. It uses coal to fill the hollow spaces in its shell, and then burns it for energy. When it blows out smoke from its nostrils and the top of its back, it sounds like a locomotive horn.
A tumbleweed-like Pokemon. Brambleghast catches prey using its branches, completely enveloping them. Once accomplished, it will not let go of the prey until all of its life energy has been drained.
A turtle-like Pokemon. Chewtle snaps at anything in front of it because of an itch of its teething. It is known to attack first with its horn, flinching them before biting down and not letting go.

A turtle-like bipedal Pokemon. Golem is able to withdraw its head, arms, and legs into its shell and roll at high speeds. Golem is dangerous when doing this, as it is unable to see and may crash into or run over anything in its path.

A two-headed Pokemon covered in a swirled substance that resembles ice cream. Vanilluxe ingests large quantities of water, which it uses to create internal snow clouds. When angered, it expels a powerful blizzard.

A two-headed, bipedal avian Pokemon. Even when sleeping or nourishing itself with food and water, one head is always awake and alert and keeps a keen eye out for enemies. Both heads have an identical brain. However, it is believed that on occasion they may possess different sets of brains.
A vaguely anthropoid Pokemon with a body made of whipped cream. When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

A vaguely humanoid Pokemon capable of spinning on its head. Hitmontop moves more quickly by spinning on the spike on its head than it does by walking normally. Capable of spinning at high speeds, it may bore into the ground similar to a drill.
A vaguely slug-like Pokemon. Goomy is widely considered the weakest Dragon-type Pokemon. It hides in damp and shady places, such as swamps, to prevent its slimy body from drying out.

A very tall Ultra Beast that resembles a vaguely humanoid mass of electrical wiring. It is speculated to sustain itself with electricity. This is supported by observations that it will "plug" its limbs and tail into the ground when it is low on energy, entering a treelike state to absorb electricity from the earth.

A virtual, manmade Pokemon. Porygon-Z was given additional software in order to increase its abilities. The initial idea was to give it the ability to travel through alien dimensions, but an error occurred. Instead, the Pokemon began acting erratically.
A vulpine Pokemon. When Thievul finds a potential target, it will secretly mark a scent on them. Thievul then uses that scent to track and stalk its targets.
A vulture-like Pokemon, particularly resembling a turkey vulture. Mandibuzz lives in nests made from the bones it finds. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.

A worm-like Pokemon that lives inside an apple. Dipplin is capable of producing syrup, which they use to coat their apple in layers. This syrup has a fragrant scent that captivates Dipplin's opponents.
A worm-like dragon Pokemon. Its cheeks store acid strong enough to induce chemical burns, which it is able to spit at its targets. It can disguise itself as an apple by folding its apple peels.

A zebra-like Pokemon. Its mane captures and stores electricity, which flashes whenever this Pokemon discharges energy. It communicates with other members of its species by controlling the rhythm and frequency of these flashes.
A zebra-like Pokemon. This irritable Pokemon fires lightning bolts from its mane when angry. Zebstrika can move as quickly as lightning, releasing thunderclaps at full gallop.
Adds Pokemon related content.
An Ultra Beast composed of stone squares stacked together to form a four-sided tower. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

An Ultra Beast mostly resembling an anthropomorphic, feminine cockroach. Pheromosa's lithe, elegant body is capable of sudden feats of acceleration, able to twitch its limbs at an estimated 120mph/200kmh instantaneously.
An Ultra Beast that has both draconic and insectoid features. It fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

An Ultra Beast that resembles a large, anthropomorphic mosquito. For unknown reasons, Buzzwole appears to strike bodybuilding poses before it performs any sort of action; this is thought to be its main form of communication, but what it could be trying to communicate is not understood.
